section_1_cloze.passage:
To me, my father, Frank Driscoll, was just a teacher, who seldom spoke of his work. I [41] paid much attention to his profession.

He was always [42] when I needed him, so like most children, I took him for granted. At 65, he retired, and while we frequently talked about my job we rarely touched upon the [43] of his teaching. Even in his final days, I did not [44] him in conversation about his career.

At the funeral (葬礼), I listened as my father's friends shared stories about their time together and what my father [45] to them. I then noticed six young individuals lined up to [46] the guest registry. Initially, I assumed they had [47] arrived at the wrong funeral. I [48] them and politely explained that this was the [49] for Frank Driscoll. One young woman told me they were my father's students a decade ago and wished to pay their [50].

I had never expected my father's students would come. Though I was [51], I invited them into the wake. They shared how my father had significantly influenced their lives. One man recalled how my father [52] him to get a better education as a safety net instead of coasting on his athletic ability. He was grateful later when his athletic career didn't [53] as expected.

Their stories about my father deeply affected me and I now [54] my father in a new light. I will no longer consider him as "just a [55]". He touched the lives of countless young individuals and quietly transformed their futures.

questions.explanation: 前句提到父亲“很少谈论他的工作(seldom spoke of his work)”，后文提到作者把父亲当作理所当然，不知其工作细节。根据句意连贯性，作者“从不(never)”关注父亲的职业。seldom和never在语意上形成递进与呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(luckily)：语境句：Luckily, she survived the terrible traffic accident. 固定搭配：luckily enough, luckily for someone
B(openly)：语境句：They discussed the controversial issue openly and honestly. 固定搭配：speak openly, openly admit
C(often)：语境句：He often stays up late to prepare for the exams. 固定搭配：often than not, as often as
D(never)：语境句：I have never seen such a beautiful sunset in my life. 固定搭配：never mind, never ever

questions.explanation: 因为父亲在我需要他的时候总是“在场/出现(present)”，所以我像大多数孩子一样觉得这是理所当然(took him for granted)。present作形容词指“在场的、出席的”，符合父亲陪伴在身边的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(busy)：语境句：She is always busy preparing lessons for her students. 固定搭配：be busy with, busy oneself with
B(content)：语境句：He is content with his simple but meaningful life. 固定搭配：be content with, content oneself with
C(silent)：语境句：The whole room kept silent when the headmaster entered. 固定搭配：remain silent, fall silent
D(present)：语境句：Every student present in the classroom passed the test. 固定搭配：be present at, at present

questions.explanation: 句意为“我们很少触及他教学的‘话题(subject)’”。touch upon/on the subject of... 是固定表达，意为“触及/谈及……的话题”。
questions.supplement:
A(reflection)：语境句：The article is a deep reflection on human nature. 固定搭配：on reflection, reflection of
B(subject)：语境句：Math is the subject that I find most difficult. 固定搭配：change the subject, touch upon the subject
C(nature)：语境句：We should respect the laws of nature to protect our earth. 固定搭配：by nature, in nature
D(capacity)：语境句：The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000. 固定搭配：in one's capacity as, capacity for

questions.explanation: 句意见作者甚至在父亲临终前也没有就他的职业与他“交谈/交流”。engage sb. in conversation 意为“与某人攀谈，使某人参与交谈”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(engage)：语境句：Teachers should try to engage students in classroom activities. 固定搭配：engage in, engage someone in conversation
B(monitor)：语境句：The government is setting up a system to monitor air quality. 固定搭配：monitor the situation, closely monitor
C(interrupt)：语境句：It is impolite to interrupt someone when they are speaking. 固定搭配：interrupt a conversation, be interrupted by
D(avoid)：语境句：We should take actions to avoid making the same mistakes. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, try to avoid

questions.explanation: 句意见“父亲的朋友们分享他们在一起的时光，以及父亲对他们来说‘意味着(meant)’什么”。mean a lot to sb / what sb meant to them 是常见搭配，表达某人对其他人的重要性。
questions.supplement:
A(promised)：语境句：He promised to help me with my English after school. 固定搭配：promise to do, make a promise
B(meant)：语境句：His encouraging words meant a lot to me during hard times. 固定搭配：mean to do, mean doing, mean a lot to
C(lent)：语境句：I lent my bicycle to him because his was broken. 固定搭配：lend sth to sb, lend a hand
D(assigned)：语境句：The teacher assigned a lot of homework for the weekend. 固定搭配：assign sb to do, assign a task

questions.explanation: 在葬礼上，来宾排队在宾客登记簿(guest registry)上“签名(sign)”。符合常理和动作逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(mark)：语境句：Please mark the important points with a red pen. 固定搭配：mark down, leave a mark
B(check)：语境句：Double check your answers before you hand in the paper. 固定搭配：check out, check in
C(copy)：语境句：Don't copy other people's work; try to do it yourself. 固定搭配：copy from, make a copy
D(sign)：语境句：You need to sign your name at the bottom of the document. 固定搭配：sign up, sign a contract

questions.explanation: 起初，作者不知道他们是父亲的学生，所以以为他们是“偶然/不小心(accidentally)”走错了葬礼。
questions.supplement:
A(publicly)：语境句：The company publicly apologized for the poor quality of its products. 固定搭配：publicly announce, state publicly
B(barely)：语境句：He spoke so quietly that I could barely hear him. 固定搭配：barely enough, can barely
C(accidentally)：语境句：I accidentally deleted the file while cleaning my computer. 固定搭配：accidentally discover, happen accidentally
D(specially)：语境句：This dress was specially designed for the upcoming festival. 固定搭配：specially designed, made specially

questions.explanation: 作者以为他们走错了，于是“走近(approached)”他们，礼貌地向他们解释。体现动作的先后连贯性。
questions.supplement:
A(warned)：语境句：The sign warned drivers to slow down near the school. 固定搭配：warn sb of sth, warn against
B(refused)：语境句：He firmly refused the offer because he had other plans. 固定搭配：refuse to do, politely refuse
C(discovered)：语境句：Scientists have discovered a new species of plants in the forest. 固定搭配：discover a way, be discovered by
D(approached)：语境句：As autumn approached, the leaves turned yellow and fell. 固定搭配：approach sb, the approach of

questions.explanation: 结合上一段提到的葬礼(funeral)和后文作者说“I invited them into the wake（守灵）”，可知作者是在向他们解释这是Frank Driscoll的“守灵/葬礼(wake)”。
questions.supplement:
A(wake)：语境句：Friends and family gathered at the wake to comfort each other. 固定搭配：attend a wake, hold a wake
B(celebration)：语境句：They held a grand celebration for the team's victory. 固定搭配：in celebration of, a celebration party
C(gift)：语境句：He has a special gift for learning foreign languages. 固定搭配：a birthday gift, have a gift for
D(comfort)：语境句：The mother's words brought great comfort to the crying child. 固定搭配：in comfort, bring comfort to

questions.explanation: 十年前的学生来参加葬礼，目的是“表达敬意/哀悼(pay their respects)”。pay one's respects (to sb) 是固定搭配，表示“对某人表示敬意，尤指吊唁”。
questions.supplement:
A(claims)：语境句：The insurance company refused to pay his medical claims. 固定搭配：make a claim, lay claim to
B(dues)：语境句：Don't forget to pay your club dues before the end of the month. 固定搭配：pay one's dues, membership dues
C(respects)：语境句：Many citizens went to the memorial to pay their respects to the heroes. 固定搭配：pay one's respects, with respects to
D(debts)：语境句：He worked two jobs in order to pay off his debts. 固定搭配：pay off debts, in debt

questions.explanation: 前句说“我从未想过父亲的学生会来”，所以此处表达作者感到非常“惊讶(astonished)”。虽然惊讶，但还是邀请他们进去。
questions.supplement:
A(excited)：语境句：The children were very excited about the trip to the zoo. 固定搭配：be excited about, get excited
B(astonished)：语境句：I was absolutely astonished to hear that he had won the first prize. 固定搭配：be astonished at/by, be astonished to see
C(confused)：语境句：The complex instructions left the students totally confused. 固定搭配：be confused about, feel confused
D(relieved)：语境句：She felt greatly relieved when she heard her son was safe. 固定搭配：feel relieved, be relieved to hear

questions.explanation: 语境表达父亲说服(persuaded/convinced)这位学生去获得更好的教育作为后路，而不是靠运动天赋混日子。convince sb to do sth意为“说服某人做某事”。此处学生回想起来充满感激，说明是循循善诱，而非强迫(forced)。
questions.supplement:
A(sponsored)：语境句：The local government sponsored the sports event to promote health. 固定搭配：be sponsored by, sponsor a program
B(challenged)：语境句：The puzzle challenged his logical thinking abilities. 固定搭配：challenge sb to do, accept a challenge
C(convinced)：语境句：I finally convinced him to give up smoking for his health. 固定搭配：convince sb of sth, convince sb to do sth
D(forced)：语境句：The heavy rain forced us to cancel the outdoor picnic. 固定搭配：force sb to do, be forced into

questions.explanation: 后来这位学生的运动生涯没有像预期的那样“成功/顺利发展(work out)”，他对此（父亲劝他多受教育）感到很感激。work out表示“（事情）进展顺利，成功”。
questions.supplement:
A(get through)：语境句：I tried calling you, but I couldn't get through. 固定搭配：get through the hard times, get through the exam
B(work out)：语境句：Don't worry, I believe everything will work out in the end. 固定搭配：work out a plan, work out well
C(come up)：语境句：A new problem has come up and needs to be solved immediately. 固定搭配：come up with, come up against
D(break off)：语境句：The two countries decided to break off their diplomatic relations. 固定搭配：break off a relationship, break off a conversation

questions.explanation: 学生的分享深深触动了作者，让作者以全新的眼光“看待/认知(perceive)”父亲。perceive ... in a new light 表示“从新的角度看待……”。
questions.supplement:
A(perceive)：语境句：People perceive the world differently based on their experiences. 固定搭配：perceive as, perceive in a new light
B(forgive)：语境句：It is sometimes hard to forgive those who have hurt us deeply. 固定搭配：forgive sb for doing, ask for forgiveness
C(remember)：语境句：Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave. 固定搭配：remember doing, remember to do
D(introduce)：语境句：Let me introduce you to my best friend, Sarah. 固定搭配：introduce sth to sb, introduce a new policy

questions.explanation: 文章开头提到“was just a teacher”，结尾处呼应首段，作者意识到父亲改变了无数年轻人的未来，决定不再把他仅仅当作“一名教师(teacher)”。
questions.supplement:
A(father)：语境句：He is a strict but loving father to his three children. 固定搭配：a good father, father figure
B(friend)：语境句：A true friend is someone who stays with you in difficult times. 固定搭配：make friends with, close friend
C(coach)：语境句：The coach guided the team to win the national championship. 固定搭配：football coach, head coach
D(teacher)：语境句：A good teacher can inspire hope and ignite the imagination. 固定搭配：school teacher, strict teacher

vocab_pack.definition_en: to mention or talk about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语为第三人称单数 father，谓语用 spoke of（speak 的过去式）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He seldom speaks of his achievements.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他很少提及自己的成就。
vocab_pack.from_passage: seldom spoke of his work

vocab_pack.definition_en: to notice or consider something carefully
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时否定，主语 I，谓语 paid（pay 的过去式），much 修饰 attention。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should pay attention to the teacher's instructions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生应该注意老师的指令。
vocab_pack.from_passage: never paid much attention to

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be in a particular place at a particular time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 he（父亲），系动词 was，always 为频率副词，present 作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to be present at important family events.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在重要的家庭活动中出席是很重要的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He was always present when I needed him

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fail to appreciate someone or something because you are so used to them
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 认为…理所当然（而不珍惜）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 I，took（take 的过去式），him 为宾语，for granted 为固定成分。
vocab_pack.example_en: Never take your parents' love for granted.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 永远不要把父母的爱视为理所当然。
vocab_pack.from_passage: took him for granted

vocab_pack.definition_en: to briefly mention a subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时（rarely 用于一般过去时），主语 we，谓语 touched upon（touch 的过去式）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lecture touched upon several important historical events.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 讲座提及了几个重要的历史事件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: rarely touched upon the subject

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start and maintain a conversation with someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时否定（did not engage），主语 I，engage 为原形（因 did 后接原形），him 为间接宾语，in conversation 为介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I tried to engage her in conversation, but she seemed shy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我试图与她交谈，但她似乎很害羞。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I did not engage him in conversation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to tell stories concerning a particular person or topic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 my father's friends，谓语 shared（share 的过去式），stories about 后接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: They shared stories about their childhood adventures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们分享了童年冒险的故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: shared stories about their time together

vocab_pack.definition_en: to form a line or queue
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 six young individuals，谓语 lined up（line 的过去式），后接 to sign 不定式表目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The students lined up to receive their diplomas.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们排队领取毕业证书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lined up to sign the guest registry

vocab_pack.definition_en: to write one's name in a book provided for visitors
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为不定式短语（to sign...），sign 为动词原形，the guest registry 为名词短语作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Guests are requested to sign the guest registry upon arrival.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请客人到达时在访客簿上签名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lined up to sign the guest registry

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think that something is true without having proof
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 I，谓语 assumed（assume 的过去式），后接 that 从句（that 省略）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't assume that everyone agrees with you.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要假设每个人都同意你。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I assumed they had accidentally arrived

vocab_pack.definition_en: by chance or mistake; not intentionally
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文在从句中修饰 arrived，置于助动词 had 之后，表示方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: He accidentally deleted the important file.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他不小心删除了重要文件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had accidentally arrived at the wrong funeral

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come to a funeral ceremony that is not the intended one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文过去完成时（had arrived），arrived 为 arrive 的过去分词，at 介词，the wrong funeral 为名词短语作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was embarrassed when she realized she had arrived at the wrong funeral.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当她意识到自己走错了葬礼时，她很尴尬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had accidentally arrived at the wrong funeral

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come near to someone or something in distance or time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 I，谓语 approached（approach 的过去式），后接代词 them 作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The stranger approached me and asked for directions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那个陌生人走近我，问路。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I approached them and politely explained

vocab_pack.definition_en: a funeral service or gathering held before the burial
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为名词，作表语（this was the wake），前面有定冠词 the。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many family members attended the wake to pay their respects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多家人参加了守灵仪式以表达敬意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this was the wake for Frank Driscoll

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show respect for someone, especially by attending a funeral or visiting them
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为不定式（wished to pay），pay 为动词原形，their 为形容词性物主代词修饰 respects。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people came to pay their respects to the deceased.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人前来向逝者表达敬意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: wished to pay their respects

vocab_pack.definition_en: to not anticipate or think something would happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为过去完成时，had 为助动词，never 为副词修饰 expected（expect 的过去分词），表示过去未曾预料。
vocab_pack.example_en: I never expected to see you here.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我从未预料到会在这里见到你。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had never expected my father's students would come

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an effect on someone or something; to shape or change
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为过去完成时（had significantly influenced），influenced 为 influence 的过去分词，与 had 构成完成时，significantly 为副词修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her teacher greatly influenced her decision to study science.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的老师极大地影响了她学习科学的决定。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had significantly influenced their lives

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: convinced him to get a better education
vocab_pack.definition_en: to persuade someone to take a particular action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，convinced（convince 的过去式），him 为宾语，to get 为不定式短语作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She convinced her friend to join the club.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她说服了她的朋友加入俱乐部。
vocab_pack.from_passage: convinced him to get a better education as a safety net

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive a higher quality or more advanced schooling
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文位于不定式 to get 中，get 为动词原形，a better education 为名词短语作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Everyone deserves a chance to get a better education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都应该有机会接受更好的教育。
vocab_pack.from_passage: convinced him to get a better education

vocab_pack.definition_en: a plan or arrangement that provides support in case of failure or difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为介词 as 的宾语，a safety net 为可数名词短语，表示一种保障。
vocab_pack.example_en: Having a part-time job can be a safety net for college graduates.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 做兼职可以作为大学毕业生的安全网。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as a safety net

vocab_pack.definition_en: to rely on one's natural ability or past success without making an effort
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 依靠（天赋或过去的成功）而不努力
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为动名词形式 coasting（coast 的现在分词），后接介词 on 及宾语 his athletic ability，在句中作介词 instead of 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He coasted on his charm for years, but eventually it wasn't enough.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他多年来靠自己的魅力混日子，但最终这并不够。
vocab_pack.from_passage: coasting on his athletic ability

vocab_pack.definition_en: to feel thankful for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 He（指那位学生），系动词 was，grateful 为形容词作表语，后接 when 时间状语从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should be grateful for the help we receive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该对所得到的帮助心怀感激。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He was grateful later when his athletic career didn't work out

vocab_pack.definition_en: to develop or end in a successful way; to have a good result
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为否定一般过去时（didn't work out），work out 为动词短语原形（因 did 后接原形），as expected 为比较状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I hope everything works out for you in the end.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我希望你最终一切顺利。
vocab_pack.from_passage: his athletic career didn't work out as expected

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the way that was anticipated or predicted
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为比较状语从句省略形式，相当于 as it was expected，修饰 didn't work out。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project was completed on time, as expected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 项目按时完成，正如预期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: didn't work out as expected

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an influence on someone or something, especially emotionally
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 Their stories，谓语 affected（affect 的过去式），后接宾语 me，deeply 为副词修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie deeply affected the audience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部电影深深打动了观众。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Their stories about my father deeply affected me

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: perceive my father in a new light

vocab_pack.definition_zh: 以新的眼光看待，重新认识
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时（现在时用于描述当前认识），主语 I，谓语 perceive，宾语 my father，in a new light 为介词短语作状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: After reading the book, I perceived the issue in a new light.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 读完这本书后，我从新的角度看待了这个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I now perceive my father in a new light

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think of someone or something as being a particular thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般将来时否定（will no longer consider），consider 为动词原形（因 will 后），him 为宾语，as 介词引出补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people consider him as a role model.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人把他视为榜样。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I will no longer consider him as 'just a teacher'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a positive or meaningful effect on many people's lives
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 He（父亲），谓语 touched（touch 的过去式），the lives of 后接宾语 countless young individuals。
vocab_pack.example_en: A great teacher can touch the lives of generations of students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一位伟大的老师可以影响几代学生的生活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He touched the lives of countless young individuals

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change something completely, usually in a positive way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般过去时，主语 He（父亲），谓语 transformed（transform 的过去式），后接宾语 their futures，quietly 为副词修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: Education can transform a person's life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教育可以改变一个人的一生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: quietly transformed their futures

vocab_pack.definition_en: a single person, especially when considered separately from a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为复数形式 individuals，作介词 of 的宾语，受 young 修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each individual has the right to express their opinion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都有表达自己意见的权利。
vocab_pack.from_passage: six young individuals

section_2_word_form.passage:
An exhibition of Chinese mural (壁画) art made its first appearance overseas at the UNESCO headquarters in Paris. The exhibition provided a platform, [56] China, France and international communities had a dialogue on cultural heritage conservation.
This exhibition featured the extraordinary murals from the Yongle Palace, which [57] (locate) in Ruicheng, Shanxi Province. The palace was built during the Yuan Dynasty (1271 - 1368), [58] (serve) as a center of worship (祭祀) during the rule of Emperor Yongle, [59] listed as a national key cultural heritage conservation unit in 1961.
In this exhibition, high technology was used for reproduction and display to let every visitor experience [60] unique charm of these murals up close, which not only exhibited [61] (exception) art skills but also held significant reference value for the study of Chinese thought, art and religious culture. The [62] (integrate) of classical culture and modern technology in the exhibition breathed new life into traditional art forms and made them accessible [63] a global audience.
With the cultural importance of these murals [64] (highlight), the exhibition symbolized the growing interest in China's rich cultural and religious heritage on the global stage and [65] (promote) better understanding and cooperation between countries in a multicultural context.

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是 platform。从句中主谓宾结构完整（China... had a dialogue），说明缺少关系副词在从句中作地点状语，表示“在这个平台上”，故填 where（或 on which，但纯填词通常填 where）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：They created an environment where everyone feels respected. 固定搭配：a platform where, situations where。无其它常见变形，注意与 which 的区分。

questions.explanation: 考查被动语态与时态。locate 作“位于”讲时常用于被动语态 be located in/at。描述壁画目前所在的永乐宫的客观地理位置，应使用一般现在时，主语 which 指代单数名词 Yongle Palace，故填 is located。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is located)：语境句：The historic museum is located in the center of the capital. 固定搭配：be located in/on/at。原词locate其它变形：location (n.), locally (adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。The palace 与 serve 之间是逻辑上的主动关系，在此处作伴随或结果状语，故使用现在分词 serving，表示“作为祭祀中心发挥作用”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(serving)：语境句：He spent 10 years serving as the president of the university. 固定搭配：serve as, serve the purpose。原词serve其它变形：service (n.), servant (n.)

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构，“The palace was built..., serving as..., [59] listed as...”。此处 listed 与前文的 built 并列，作 was 的表语/被动语态的一部分（The palace was built ... and was listed ...），省略了前面的 was，因此需要填入并列连词 and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The building was designed by a famous architect and completed in 2020. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。属于基础并列连词。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。experience 的宾语是 unique charm，后面有 of these murals 限定，表示“这些壁画特有的魅力”，属于特指，应使用定冠词 the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：The beauty of the lake attracts thousands of tourists every year. 固定搭配：the charm of, the importance of。无变形，注意与 a/an (泛指) 的区别。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处修饰名词词组 art skills，需要用到 exception 的形容词形式 exceptional，意为“卓越的，非凡的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(exceptional)：语境句：The young musician showed exceptional talent at an early age. 固定搭配：exceptional skills, exceptional talent。原词exception其它变形：except (prep.), exceptionally (adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。位于定冠词 The 和介词 of 之间，作句子的主语，应填入 integrate 的名词形式 integration，表示“古典文化与现代技术的融合”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(integration)：语境句：The integration of theory and practice is vital in education. 固定搭配：the integration of A and B, economic integration。原词integrate其它变形：integrate (v.), integrated (adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。固定搭配 be accessible to sb 意为“对某人来说可接近的/可获取的/可欣赏的”，这里指让全球观众都能接触到这些艺术形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The new database is easily accessible to all the staff members. 固定搭配：be accessible to, open to。为基础介词搭配考点。

questions.explanation: 考查 with 复合结构 (with + 宾语 + 宾语补足语)。宾语 the cultural importance of these murals 与动词 highlight 之间是被动关系（重要性被凸显），因此使用过去分词 highlighted 作宾补。
questions.supplement: 正确形(highlighted)：语境句：With the main problems highlighted, the team began to seek solutions. 固定搭配：highlight the importance, be highlighted by。原词highlight其它变形：highlight (n./v.原形)

questions.explanation: 考查时态及并列结构。此处与前面的 symbolized 并列，共同作 the exhibition 的谓语动词，叙述已发生的客观事实，因此需用一般过去时 promoted。
questions.supplement: 正确形(promoted)：语境句：The successful campaign promoted global awareness of environmental protection. 固定搭配：promote understanding, promote cooperation。原词promote其它变形：promotion (n.), promoter (n.)

vocab_pack.definition_en: a painting or other work of art executed directly on a wall
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作为名词修饰语使用，出现在 'mural art' 中，表示壁画艺术。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient temple contains stunning murals that depict scenes from mythology.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古庙内藏有描绘神话场景的精美壁画。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Chinese mural art

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attend an event or be seen in a particular place, especially for the first time or after a long absence
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为过去时态（made），主语为单数（exhibition），并带有形容词性物主代词 its 和序数词 first 修饰 appearance，整体表示「首次亮相」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The famous singer will make an appearance at the charity concert tonight.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位著名歌手今晚将在慈善音乐会上亮相。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made its first appearance

vocab_pack.definition_en: in or to a foreign country, especially one across the sea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作副词，修饰 made its first appearance，表示「在海外」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He plans to study overseas after graduating from high school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他计划高中毕业后去海外留学。
vocab_pack.from_passage: overseas at the UNESCO headquarters

vocab_pack.definition_en: the place from which an organization is controlled or directed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作介词 at 的宾语，表示地点「在联合国教科文组织总部」；headquarters 为复数形式，但常视为单数或复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company's headquarters is located in New York.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司总部位于纽约。
vocab_pack.from_passage: at the UNESCO headquarters

vocab_pack.definition_en: a raised level surface on which people or things can stand; a place or opportunity for expressing opinions or for communication
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作 provided 的宾语（a platform），后接定语从句 where...，表示提供了一个对话的平台。
vocab_pack.example_en: The conference provided a platform for young scientists to share their research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次会议为年轻科学家提供了一个分享研究成果的平台。
vocab_pack.from_passage: provided a platform

vocab_pack.definition_en: conversation between two or more people; a discussion aimed at reaching an agreement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作 had 的宾语，后接介词 on 表示关于某话题的对话；注意 dialogue 既可以是可数名词也可以是不可数名词，此处为可数（a dialogue）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two countries have started a dialogue on climate change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 两国已就气候变化问题展开对话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had a dialogue on

vocab_pack.definition_en: property that is or may be inherited; valued objects and qualities such as cultural traditions, historical buildings, etc. that are passed down from previous generations
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作 cultural heritage conservation 的一部分，表示文化遗产，是名词作定语修饰 conservation。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government is making efforts to protect the country's cultural heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府正在努力保护国家的文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cultural heritage conservation

vocab_pack.definition_en: the protection of natural things such as forests, water, and wildlife; also the preservation of cultural artifacts
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 保护；保存（尤指对自然或文化遗产）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作 cultural heritage conservation 的核心名词，表示文化遗产保护。
vocab_pack.example_en: Conservation of water resources is crucial in arid regions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在干旱地区，水资源的保护至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cultural heritage conservation

vocab_pack.definition_en: very unusual or remarkable; exceptionally good
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作定语修饰 murals，表示「非凡的壁画」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scientist made extraordinary contributions to medical research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位科学家对医学研究做出了非凡的贡献。
vocab_pack.from_passage: extraordinary murals

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be situated in a particular place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中“is located”为一般现在时被动语态（be + past participle），表示状态；后接介词 in 引出地点；主语 which 指代 the Yongle Palace，故谓语用单数 is。
vocab_pack.example_en: The famous university is located in the capital city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那所著名大学位于首都。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which is located in

vocab_pack.definition_en: to function or act as something; to be used for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中“serving as”为现在分词短语，作伴随状语或补充说明，表示（在永乐皇帝统治期间）用作祭祀中心。serve 用现在分词形式，与主语 the palace 构成主动关系。
vocab_pack.example_en: This small room can serve as a study.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个小房间可以充当书房。
vocab_pack.from_passage: serving as a center of worship

vocab_pack.definition_en: the feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity; religious ceremonies
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作介词 of 的宾语，构成 a center of worship，意为「祭祀中心」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient temple was a place of worship for local people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古庙是当地人的礼拜场所。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a center of worship

vocab_pack.definition_en: a period of time during which a particular person or group controls a country; government
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作介词 during 的宾语，构成 during the rule of Emperor Yongle，表示「在永乐皇帝统治期间」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The country experienced great prosperity during the rule of that emperor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该国在那个皇帝的统治期间经历了巨大的繁荣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: during the rule of Emperor Yongle

vocab_pack.definition_en: to include something in a list; to officially record or designate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中“listed as”为过去分词被动语态，与 was built, serving 并列（部分平行结构），表示「被列为」；主语 the palace 被列出。
vocab_pack.example_en: The building was listed as a historic site in 1990.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该建筑于1990年被列为历史遗址。
vocab_pack.from_passage: listed as a national key cultural heritage conservation unit

vocab_pack.definition_en: the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作主语 high technology 的中心词，表示「高科技」被用于复制和展示。
vocab_pack.example_en: Modern technology has greatly changed the way we communicate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 现代科技极大地改变了我们的交流方式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: high technology was used

vocab_pack.definition_en: the action or process of making a copy of something; a copy of a work of art
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中与 display 并列作介词 for 的宾语，表示用于复制和展示的目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum sells high-quality reproductions of famous paintings.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆出售名画的高质量复制品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: for reproduction and display

vocab_pack.definition_en: an arrangement of items for people to see; the act of showing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中与 reproduction 并列作介词 for 的宾语，表示展示的目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new product is on display at the exhibition hall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该新产品正在展览厅展出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: for reproduction and display

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come to know or feel something; to live through an event or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为动词原形，用在 let every visitor experience 结构中，let 后接宾语加不带 to 的动词不定式，experience 表示「让每位参观者近距离体验」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The tour allows visitors to experience local culture firsthand.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次旅行让游客亲身体验当地文化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: let every visitor experience the unique charm

vocab_pack.definition_en: the power or quality of delighting, attracting, or fascinating others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作 experience 的宾语，被 unique 修饰，表示「独特的魅力」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The old town has a charm that attracts tourists from all over the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古镇有一种吸引世界各地游客的魅力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the unique charm

vocab_pack.definition_en: very near to something; in close proximity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作状语修饰 experience，表示「近距离地体验」。
vocab_pack.example_en: You can see the details of the painting up close.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你可以近距离看到这幅画的细节。
vocab_pack.from_passage: up close

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or display something publicly; to demonstrate a quality or feeling
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为过去式，与 held 并列作 which 从句的谓语，表示（这些壁画）「展现出非凡的艺术技巧」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist will exhibit his latest works at the gallery next month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家下个月将在画廊展出他的最新作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which not only exhibited exceptional art skills

vocab_pack.definition_en: unusually good; outstanding
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作定语修饰 art skills，表示「非凡的艺术技巧」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has exceptional talent in playing the piano.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她具有非凡的钢琴演奏天赋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: exceptional art skills

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act or process of combining two or more things so that they work together effectively
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作主语，由 of classical culture and modern technology 修饰，表示古典文化与现代科技的融合。
vocab_pack.example_en: The integration of technology into education has improved learning outcomes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 技术融入教育提高了学习效果。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The integration of classical culture and modern technology

vocab_pack.definition_en: to revitalize or rejuvenate something; to make something more exciting or interesting again
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 给...注入新的活力；使...焕然一新
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为过去式 breathed，主语为 The integration...，表示这种融合给传统艺术形式注入了新的生命。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new manager hopes to breathe new life into the failing company.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新经理希望给这家濒临倒闭的公司注入新的活力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: breathed new life into traditional art forms

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to be available or easy to reach or use for a particular group
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使...可被...获得/接触到；使...对...开放
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中 make 为过去式 made，them 指代 traditional art forms，accessible 为形容词作宾语补足语，后接 to 引出受众，表示「使它们对全球观众来说变得可接触」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy aims to make education accessible to all children.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策旨在使所有儿童都能接受教育。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made them accessible to a global audience

vocab_pack.definition_en: to emphasize or draw attention to something; to make something prominent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为过去分词，用于 with + 宾语 + 过去分词结构（独立主格），表示「随着这些壁画的文化重要性被强调」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report highlights the need for more funding in education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 报告强调了教育需要更多资金。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With the cultural importance of these murals highlighted

vocab_pack.definition_en: to represent or stand for something as a symbol
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为过去式，作 exhibition 的谓语，后接宾语 the growing interest...，表示展览象征了对中国丰富文化遗产日益增长的兴趣。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove symbolizes peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子象征和平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the exhibition symbolized the growing interest

vocab_pack.definition_en: an increasing level of curiosity, attention, or concern about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中作 symbolized 的宾语，growing 为现在分词作定语修饰 interest，表示「日益增长的兴趣」。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is a growing interest in sustainable living among young people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 年轻人对可持续生活方式的兴趣日益浓厚。
vocab_pack.from_passage: symbolized the growing interest in China's rich cultural and religious heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to support or encourage the progress or development of something; to advocate for
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中为过去式，与 symbolized 并列作 exhibition 的谓语，后接 better understanding and cooperation，表示「促进更好的理解与合作」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating habits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项运动旨在推广健康的饮食习惯。
vocab_pack.from_passage: promoted better understanding and cooperation

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of working together towards a common goal; assistance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中与 understanding 并列作 promoted 的宾语，表示「促进更好的理解与合作」。
vocab_pack.example_en: International cooperation is essential to solve global problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 国际合作对于解决全球问题是必要的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: promoted better understanding and cooperation
